text:
Avery: Hi team — weird last-minute thing. I lost my physical card and the specialist receptionist is asking for proof of active coverage for a same-day referral. Can I get a temporary proof/letter or is a screenshot of the insurer app enough? Appointment is in ~3 hours.

Priya (Benefits): Hi Avery — screenshot from the insurer app usually works at intake, but some clinics insist on an official proof of coverage letter. We can generate a temporary letter from the benefits portal and email it; takes ~30–60 mins if you include the provider details.

Avery: Awesome. What details do you need from me? NPI? provider name?

Priya (Benefits): Provider name + address + appointment time is helpful. If they want a referral code or authorization number we can request that too. Also include your employee ID or DOB so we can pull your record quickly. If you want to copy/paste, use this email template to benefits@redwood.com:

```
Subject: Urgent temporary proof of coverage — same-day appointment
Body:
Employee name: Avery
Employee ID: 012345
DOB: 1990-05-18
Insurer: RedwoodCare (or plan name)
Appointment date/time: 2024-06-05 14:30
Provider: Dr. Lin / Lakeside Specialty Clinic
Provider NPI (if known): 1234567890
Notes: Need temporary proof/letter for clinic check-in; appointment is same-day.
```

Jordan (People Ops): Also — if you can, log into the insurer mobile app and screenshot the main card page (policy number + name). That often clears check-in instantly. If the clinic refuses, Priya can push the formal letter. If you want, I can file the request for you with the benefits team right now.

Avery: Uploading screenshot now. Also sending the details via the template. Thanks!

PeopleOpsBot: Ticket created — case #PO-8421. Benefits team assigned: Priya. Expected turnaround: 1 business day (expedite requested for same-day appointment).

Priya (Benefits): Got the request and screenshot, Avery — starting the temporary letter generation now. Will DM you the PDF and also email the clinic a confirmation if you want us to. If clinic needs an authorization number we may need a short phone call with the insurer; I'll call them immediately.

Avery: Please email the clinic if you can — they'll accept an emailed PDF. Really appreciate the fast help. :pray:
